The '''CP-2 Bryar Pistol''' was a type of [[Bryar pistol/Legends|Bryar]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It could be stored in a tailored holster.<ref name="Cartel Market" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The CP-2 Bryar Pistol was designed by concept artist [[Bradley W. Lewis]]<ref name="Concept">{{ArtStation|username=nonentity|url=artwork/obzeBk|name=[[Bradley W. Lewis|Bradley Lewis]]|text=SWTOR &#124; CP-2 Bryar Pistol|date=2023-07-11|quote=This is a pistol and holster set I made for SWTOR inspired by the Bryar pistol featured in Andor. I based this off a real-world Colt Python 357 Magnum, and added the rotating front chamber, as well as animated cylinder and hammer. The illuminated sections reflect player chosen color crystal. This was featured in our Andor tie-in bundle which included Cassian Andor's outfit and dye packs.}}</ref> for [[BioWare]]'s [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' and was added to the [[Cartel Market]] on [[June 13]] [[2023]] as part of a bundle based on the [[Andor Season 1|Season 1]] of the [[Canon]] television series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor]]<ref name="TOR web">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230613-0|text=Cartel Market Additions: Game Update 7.3}}</ref> released in [[2022]].<ref name="Andor Trivia2">{{SW|url=andor-s1-e3-trivia-gallery|text="Reckoning" Trivia Gallery &#124; Andor}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref> Its design is inspired by<ref name="Concept" /> the [[MW-20 Bryar pistol|MW-20 Bryar Pistol]] [[Clem's blaster pistol|wielded]] by the series protagonist [[Cassian Jeron Andor]]<ref name="Andor Trivia2" /> and is also based on the real-world [[Wikipedia:Colt Python|Colt Python]] [[Wikipedia:.357 Magnum|.357 Magnum]].<ref name="Concept" />
